title: VHF Lower Blade Antenna — Removal
abstract: Removal of a lower blade antenna from the fuselage antenna land, with the bonding measurement taken before the antenna is disturbed and the land condition record that decides whether the land needs re-preparation.

sections.purpose: To remove a lower blade antenna from the fuselage antenna land for replacement or for inspection of the land.
sections.job_setup_note: The aircraft must be de-powered and the radio set isolated before the antenna is disturbed. A working platform or a tail dock is needed for the lower fuselage position. The bonding resistance must be measured and recorded before anything is loosened, because it is the only evidence of what the land condition was. Two persons are needed.
sections.procedure: Put the safety barriers in position. Remove the electrical power and put the warning notices in position. Isolate and collar the circuit breaker for the affected radio set. WARNING: DO NOT REMOVE AN ANTENNA WITH THE RADIO SET POWERED. THE TRANSMITTER CAN BE KEYED FROM THE FLIGHT COMPARTMENT WITHOUT WARNING TO THE PERSON AT THE ANTENNA. Put the working platform in position under the antenna and set the brakes. Measure the bonding resistance between the antenna base and the airframe and record the value. Remove the sealant fillet around the antenna base with the nylon scraper. CAUTION: DO NOT USE A METAL SCRAPER OR A POWERED TOOL ON THE SEALANT FILLET. THE ANTENNA LAND SURFACE TREATMENT IS EASILY REMOVED AND MUST THEN BE FULLY RE-PREPARED. Remove the screws AGS216702-16 and the washers EN561587K4 from the antenna base, working from the centre outwards. Support the antenna and break the sealant bond with the nylon wedge. Lower the antenna clear and disconnect the coaxial connector as it becomes accessible. Cap the coaxial connector immediately. Examine the antenna land for corrosion product, for loss of surface treatment and for fretting at the screw positions, and record the condition. Examine the antenna base sealing face and the blade for erosion.
sections.close_out: Cover the antenna land with the protective blank and seal it against weather if the aircraft is to be left. Make sure that the coaxial connector is capped and supported. Remove the working platform. Remove the collar from the circuit breaker only when the antenna has been reinstalled. Record the removal, the antenna part number, the bonding value measured before removal and the land condition.

type_data.effectivity_note: All aircraft. The ground plane skirt differs on aircraft post MOD-111925.

safety_precautions: Do not remove an antenna with the radio set powered.
Isolate and collar the circuit breaker for the affected set.
Do not use a metal scraper or a powered tool on the sealant fillet.

tooling.description: Nylon scraper and wedge set, antenna
